_readme.description: თბილისის რეალური ფიტნეს-დარბაზები და გარე ვორკაუტ-მოედნები. იმპორტი: TbilisiSpotSeeder (idempotent by external_id).
_readme.source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API (area: Tbilisi admin_level=4) + official chain websites for cross-check
overpass_filters: supplement: named gyms missing fitness tags (osm:node/12445349534, osm:way/506855428, osm:node/9929197430, osm:node/4194248289)
rules: fitness_station / pitch: stations within 40 m of a cluster seed (and clusters < 50 m apart) are merged into one spot; equipment = union of fitness_station values
type: school/stadium/park when the point lies inside such an OSM polygon, otherwise yard; schools get access=restricted
unnamed stations: "<enclosing park> — ფიტნეს-მოედანი" or "ფიტნეს-მოედანი — <nearest named street ≤ 250 m>"; otherwise excluded
address for outdoor spots = nearest named street (not a postal address)
fitness_centre: yoga/pilates/stretch/dance/martial-arts/boxing/swimming-only studios and unnamed centres excluded
verified_url: official chain page that confirmed the branch; its phone/hours override OSM
